# Stickyy 1.2.8
## Faster structure, more accurate paste
- The floating-note paste action now inserts the most recently copied text, even when older Clipboard Pills are pinned above it. - Type `- ` at the beginning of a line for a solid bullet. Press Return to continue the list, or Return on an empty bullet to finish it. - Type `->` to insert a right arrow. - Type `---` to create a section divider. A compact dot navigator appears on the right edge so you can jump between sections in either note style. - Liquid Glass keeps its background blur when section navigation appears. - The dot navigator stays compact and scrollable with long notes, and can be turned off under Editor in Settings. - Right-clicking the menu-bar icon now opens Settings reliably. - A small, non-intrusive ready card appears for three seconds when Stickyy starts or launches at login.
